unmapped_files.why: Ensembl VEP's annotated copy of the input somatic VCF (ENSEMBLVEP_VEP in conf/modules.config): the same calls with consequences added, not a second call set, as sarek's map rules out its annotated copies.
BCFTOOLS_VIEW -f PASS: the input VCF cut to its PASS calls, the pipeline's working copy of a call set registered elsewhere, not a new one.
vcf2cnaqc and cna2cnaqc RDS conversions of the input VCF and copy-number segments, and cnaqc2tsv's per-patient joint mutation table: format conversions read by the later steps.

bcftools mpileup of each sample's private mutations in the patient's other tumour BAMs, its stats, the position lists and RDS objects (only with tumour_alignment): intermediates merged back into the mutation tables.
TINC's fit, plots and qc.csv: tumour-in-normal contamination and tumour purity estimates. No sample type has an attribute for either; a schema request, not a rule.
CNAqc's per-sample objects and PDFs: a check of the input copy-number segments against the mutations' allele frequencies, not new copy-number calls, so not an A.CNV; no sample type holds a QC object.
join_CNAqc's per-patient multi-sample CNAqc object, the input to subclonal deconvolution: an intermediate with no sample type.

annotate_driver's RDS: each sample's mutations flagged against the IntOGen driver table for its cancer_type. No sample type means annotated driver calls (G-5); proposed as a new type in the tumourevo README section.

MOBSTER, PyClone-VI and VIBER cluster fits, ctree clone trees, their reports, and SigProfiler's genome under this folder. No sample type means a clonal-structure result (G-5); proposed as a new type in the tumourevo README section.

SparseSignatures and SigProfiler per-dataset signature extraction (counts, exposures, solutions). No sample type means mutational signatures (G-5); proposed as a new type in the tumourevo README section.
The VEP cache tumourevo downloaded or unpacked (ENSEMBLVEP_DOWNLOAD, UNTAR): reference files, not sample data.
